changelog.entry: The first three sky seasons: 24 charts of real constellations in Winter, Spring and Summer Sky, from Auriga and Lyra to Orion, Ursa Major and Scorpius. Join the stars so every number holds, no lines cross and the lines make one figure; the constellation then goes into your Sky Atlas, drawn at its real place in the sky, with a card (its note, brightest star and best month to see it). Five finished charts in a season open the next page. Every chart was proved to have exactly one answer and to be finishable by following the numbers. Chart as text, star letters and keyboard play are there for everyone.
